description:
**Company Description** 
 Triqos International Institute of Beauty and Hair is a leading training institute specializing in beauty parlor classes and professional courses in beauty and hair. The institute is known for offering a wide range of programs, including beautician courses, hair cutting classes, nail art training, and professional make\-up education. It provides focused training in areas such as mehndi, bridal and party make\-up, and advanced beauty techniques. Learners benefit from practical, industry\-relevant instruction designed to prepare them for successful careers in the beauty and hair industry.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Performance Marketer role based in Ahmedabad. The Performance Marketer will plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across channels such as search, social media, and display to drive leads and course enrollments. Responsibilities include managing paid advertising budgets, tracking key performance metrics, conducting A/B tests, and improving campaign targeting and creatives. The role also involves collaborating with the admissions and content teams to align messaging, analyzing campaign data to provide insights and reports, and continuously identifying opportunities to increase ROI and brand visibility.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess skills in digital campaign management, including planning, execution, and optimization of paid media campaigns.
* Candidates should possess skills in data analysis and performance tracking, such as monitoring KPIs, using analytics tools, and generating actionable reports.
* Candidates should possess skills in audience targeting and segmentation, including understanding user behavior, lead funnels, and conversion optimization.
* Candidates should possess skills in marketing communication, including clear written communication, basic ad copywriting, and collaboration with creative teams.
* Previous experience in performance marketing for education, training, or consumer services is beneficial.
* Familiarity with major advertising platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics) is preferred.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on\-site in Ahmedabad, manage multiple campaigns simultaneously, and meet performance targets in a fast\-paced environment.

description:
**About Business**

**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. * Collaborate with legal teams to review contracts and MSAs for DLP compliance.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
* 10–12 years of experience in data loss prevention, data discovery/classification, and database/data security.
* Experience with DSPM tools and integration in hybrid environments.
* Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST.
* Experience with DLP, DSPM, disk encryption tools and automation.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or OSCP are a plus.

* Ability to stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.

title: Senior Student Counsellor
description:
Manifest Global empowers in building companies that connect the world towards growth, prosperity, and innovation. Our portfolio includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, BridgeU, Explore, and Kaaiser, which are dedicated to expanding global student mobility by serving their respective stakeholders in the ecosystem.
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 To create a world where every student, regardless of their ethnicity, nationality, socio\-economic status, and learning preference, gets equal access to higher education through our world\-class network of portfolio brands; a network that globally connects community stakeholders that provide the finest resources and support material, anywhere in the world and at any time.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 Every year, tens of thousands of Indian students decide they want to study in Europe, and most of them are making that decision with almost nothing to go on. Unlike the well\-worn paths to the US, UK, or Australia, Europe's university systems, visa rules, and application timelines vary by country, and until recently there was no single place in India built specifically to make sense of it. Families take out loans, sell assets, or bet a year of a child's life on a decision they are navigating largely in the dark.
   

  

 EduGo Abroad exists to close that gap. As India's only platform dedicated specifically to European education, it has spent over fifteen years building the trust, the university relationships, and the process knowledge that a fragmented, agent\-by\-agent market never had. That trust is not abstract. It shows up as thousands of students who have already been placed, and thousands more currently mid\-decision, each one needing someone who can turn a confusing set of options into a clear, confident next step.
   

  

 This role sits at the point where that trust is either earned or lost. You are the person a student and their family actually talk to, week after week, from the first conversation about what's possible through to the day they get on a plane. Everything EduGo has built as a platform, network, and reputation runs through the quality of that conversation.
   

  

 At the highest level, this role owns the full counselling relationship with a portfolio of students, from first contact through to enrolment and visa outcome.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most study\-abroad counselling in India happens through agents who work by referral fee and volume, with limited real accountability for whether a student ends up in the right programme. EduGo counsellors work differently: you are backed by direct university partnerships, a dedicated European course database, and a platform built to remove friction rather than add it. You are not selling a generic "study abroad" dream. You are the specialist in one continent, which means you can go deeper, faster, and with more credibility than a generalist agent ever could.
   

  

 As part of Manifest Global, this role also sits inside a broader ecosystem of study\-abroad expertise: Kaaiser's decades of counselling experience in the India\-to\-Australia corridor, Cialfo's platform trust with schools, and the shared operating discipline of a group that has scaled this exact playbook before. No standalone European education agency in India has that depth behind it.
   

  

 The broader overseas education industry is contracting. EduGo is growing.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Student and parent counselling**
* Own the counselling relationship with an assigned portfolio of prospective students and their families
* Translate each student's academic background, budget, and ambitions into a realistic, well\-matched set of European university and course options
* Guide students through interview preparation and every stage of the admission process, from shortlist to offer


**Premium and high\-value accounts**
* Own a subset of premium student profiles with an elevated standard of responsiveness and personalisation
* Act as the single point of contact across the full application and admission journey, so no student is passed between people mid\-decision


**Pipeline and conversion**
* Drive each lead from first counselling conversation through application, conversion, and enrolment
* Identify where conversion is slipping in your own pipeline and adjust your approach — follow\-up cadence, objection handling, positioning — rather than waiting to be told
* Ensure every interaction, follow\-up, and outcome is logged accurately in the CRM


**Coordination and market knowledge**
* Coordinate with internal teams and university partners to keep applications, admissions, and enrolments moving without gaps
* Stay current on university requirements, visa guidelines, and course changes across your countries of focus, and flag anything that changes how a student should be advised


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where EduGo's counselling team is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In your first weeks, you are learning the European university landscape in enough depth to have a real conversation with a student — not reciting course names, but explaining why one path fits them better than another. You are also learning EduGo's process end to end, from first counselling call to visa outcome, so you know exactly where a student's application actually stands at any moment.
   

  

 By the middle of your first year, students in your portfolio are moving through the funnel with noticeably less friction. You've built a rhythm of follow\-up that doesn't feel like nagging, and families trust you enough to come back with hard questions instead of going quiet. Your CRM data is clean enough that anyone could pick up a case mid\-stream and understand where it stands.
   

  

 Over the longer term, you've built a reputation — with students, with parents, and internally — as someone whose portfolio simply performs, and whose judgment on a borderline case is trusted. The relationships you've built outlast any single admission cycle.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You've counselled students on study\-abroad decisions before, and you understand that this is rarely a purely rational purchase — it's a family decision with real financial and emotional weight behind it, and you know how to hold both the commercial and human sides of that conversation at once.
   

  

 You communicate with the kind of clarity and warmth that makes a nervous parent relax. You can explain a visa requirement or a course structure in plain language, and you're comfortable being direct when a student's expectations don't match reality, because you know that's more useful to them than false reassurance.
   

  

 You bring a positive, determined approach to a sales cycle that has real ups and downs — leads go quiet, plans change, deadlines slip — and you don't let that erode your consistency with the students still counting on you.
   

  

 You think critically rather than following a script. When something about a case doesn't add up — a mismatched course choice, an unrealistic timeline — you're the one who catches it before it becomes a problem.
   

  

 You're coachable. You stay current on an industry that changes constantly — new visa rules, new university requirements, new competitive dynamics — because you understand that what you knew last intake isn't automatically still true.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what EduGo is building and your first reaction was that this is exactly the kind of trust\-building work you want to be doing. That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early

title: Senior Student Counsellor
description:
**Designation:** 
 Student Counsellor/Senior Student Counsellor
 



**Department** 
 : B2C Student Counselling
 




**Location:** 
 Ambli, Ahmedabad
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Work Schedule:** 
 6 days a week \| Sunday Off
 



  





**Company Description:** 




 EduGo Abroad has over 15 years of expertise as India's only platform dedicated to Europe education, offering tailored, tech\-driven solutions for students, partners, and universities. The platform connects stakeholders with over 25 countries, 550 universities, and 10,000 courses, making it the top choice for European education services. EduGo Abroad provides students comprehensive guidance on admissions, visas, and accommodation while supporting partners with an extensive course database and universities with access to a vast network. Recognized by top media platforms such as India Today and Financial Express, EduGo Abroad is a trusted pioneer in European education, committed to delivering exceptional opportunities globally.
 



  





**Role Description:** 



* Counsel prospective students and parents on international education opportunities, including universities, courses, programs, and study destinations.
* Understand students’ academic backgrounds, career aspirations, preferences, and financial considerations to provide personalized study\-abroad guidance.
* Manage leads throughout the complete sales funnel, from initial counselling and profile assessment to application, conversion, and enrolment.
* Drive admissions and revenue through consultative selling, timely follow\-ups, relationship building, and effective objection handling.
* Manage premium and high\-value student profiles while ensuring a high standard of service and personalized customer experience.
* Guide and prepare students for university interviews and other stages of the admission process.
* Act as the primary point of contact for students throughout their application and admission journey, ensuring timely communication and support.
* Achieve intake\-wise admission and visa targets in line with organizational business objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with students and parents throughout the decision\-making and application journey.



  





**Requisite Skills:** 




 ·      Should have Experience in the same field
 



 ·      Excellent communication skills.
 



 ·      Positive, confident and determined approach.
 



 ·      High degree of self\-motivation and ambition.
 



 ·      Should be Aware of Developments into Education Industry
 



 ·      Should be a Critical Thinker
 



 ·      Should be Adaptable to continuous Learning
 



 ·      Should Understand Diverse Cultures \& Respect the same
 



 ·      Should be Inspirational to Students

title: Walk-in Drive of Growth Marketer
description:
Growth Marketer — BetterBugs
 



  
 



 BetterBugs is hiring
 **Growth Marketer** 
  in Ahmedabad.
 



**Role:** 
 Growth Marketer 
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 In\-office (Ahmedabad)
 



**Shift:** 
 Regular
 



  





  About BetterBugs
 



 BetterBugs.io is a browser\-based bug reporting and debugging platform built for QA and development teams. Our Chrome extension lets anyone capture screenshots, screen recordings, and "Rewind" clips of a bug in one click — with console logs, network requests, and environment data auto\-attached. Reports push straight into Jira, Linear, GitHub, Slack, and more, and our built\-in AI Debugger helps teams find root causes faster. We help software teams cut the back\-and\-forth between QA, support, and engineering — making bug reporting up to 10x faster.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We're looking for a Growth Marketer to own BetterBugs marketing end\-to\-end. This isn't an execution\-only role — you'll be responsible for outcomes across content, SEO, and social as one connected function, and for running growth experiments across the full funnel. You'll work across all of BetterBugs' core products and buyer types, so you'll need to move comfortably between technical and non\-technical audiences.
 



  





 What the Role Involves
 


* Owning BetterBugs marketing end\-to\-end — content, SEO, and social run as one integrated function rather than separate workstreams
* Driving growth experiments across the funnel, from top\-of\-funnel acquisition through activation and conversion
* Working across all three core products and buyer types — adapting messaging and channels for QA teams, engineering/dev teams, and product/support teams
* Identifying what's working through data, then doubling down — and killing what isn't
* Collaborating closely with sales (inbound/outbound BDM and SDR functions) on lead quality, messaging, and campaign feedback
* Representing BetterBugs' voice consistently across content, SEO\-driven pages, and social channels



 What We're Looking For
 


* 3–5 years of experience owning marketing outcomes, not just executing on a brief — you've been accountable for growth numbers, not just deliverables
* Strong grounding across content, SEO, and social — comfortable running all three rather than specializing in just one
* Comfort operating in a technical, B2B SaaS environment, with the ability to translate technical product capabilities into compelling positioning
* A experimental mindset — able to design, run, and interpret growth experiments across the funnel
* Data\-driven approach to prioritization, with comfort using analytics to guide decisions



 Nice to Have
 


* Prior experience marketing to developers, QA teams, or technical B2B buyers
* Experience with dev\-tools, SaaS, or product\-led growth (PLG) companies
* Familiarity with SEO/content tooling and growth experimentation frameworks



 What We Offer
 


* End\-to\-end ownership of marketing — real influence over strategy, not just execution
* Fast\-growing product with strong early traction (Product Hunt, active user base)



  





 📅 Walk\-in Date: Friday \& Saturday – 25th \& 26th September 2026
 



 ⏰ Time: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
 



 📍 Venue: BetterBugs, 402, Dwarkesh Business Hub, Opp. Visamo Society, Motera, Ahmedabad – 380005
 


* Please complete this registration form if you intend to attend the walk\-in drive.
* Registration link: https://forms.gle/BqgKD1MJTjhDGHeP9
* Carry your updated resume with you.

title: Advertising Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 StarAdwise is a digital marketing agency focused on helping brands grow through data\-driven strategies and measurable performance. The team specializes in performance marketing, SEO, content strategy, branding, and social media management to strengthen clients’ digital presence. By understanding each client’s unique business needs, StarAdwise designs tailored campaigns that effectively reach and engage target audiences. The agency is committed to maximizing ROI, improving online visibility, and crafting compelling brand narratives. StarAdwise values collaboration and long\-term partnerships to help organizations achieve their digital growth goals.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Advertising Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing digital advertising campaigns across channels such as search, social media, and display. Day\-to\-day tasks include setting up campaigns, managing budgets, monitoring performance metrics, and adjusting strategies to improve ROI and conversion rates. The Advertising Specialist will collaborate with marketing, content, and design teams to develop compelling ad creatives and messaging aligned with brand objectives. Additional responsibilities include preparing campaign reports, presenting insights to stakeholders, and staying current with industry trends and platform updates.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Data Analysis capabilities to evaluate campaign performance and optimize results.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with internal teams and present advertising plans and results clearly.
* Candidates should possess Marketing expertise, including knowledge of digital advertising platforms, audience targeting, and campaign strategy.
* Candidates should possess Sales and conversion\-focused skills to design campaigns that drive leads, revenue, and measurable outcomes.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field are beneficial.
* Experience with tools like Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and other reporting platforms is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple campaigns simultaneously, and meet deadlines is preferred.

 Strong knowledge of Google Search Ads, Display Ads, Performance Max, Remarketing, and Lead Generation campaigns.
 



 Excellent understanding of keyword research, match types, negative keywords, bidding strategies, audience targeting, and campaign optimization.
 



 Experience with Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach.
 



 Ability to manage multiple campaigns and budgets simultaneously.
 



 Good written and verbal communication skills.

 SaaS / Software Products

 will be preferred.

title: Management Trainee Program
description:
This is not your typical internship.
 
  





 Most internships teach you a function. This program is designed to teach you something bigger — how businesses actually grow. MeDigit is selecting 3 ambitious college students / freshers to join the MeDigit Business Growth Program as Business Growth Operators. You’ll work alongside the MeDigit team on live businesses, real growth challenges and actual outcomes. The idea is simple: instead of learning marketing through theory or dummy projects, you learn by being part of real business growth.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Management Trainee Program at MeDigit Advertising Private Limited is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. The trainee will support day\-to\-day program coordination, assist in planning and executing client\-focused initiatives, and help monitor progress against revenue and demand generation goals. Responsibilities include analyzing campaign data, preparing reports, participating in internal training sessions, and shadowing senior team members across functions such as client servicing, digital strategy, and operations. The role also involves communicating with internal stakeholders, contributing to process improvements, and learning to manage small projects under supervision.
 



  





**Opportunity:** 
 Internship / Management Trainee Program
 



**Openings:** 
 Only 3
   





 What will you do?
 
* Work on live brands and understand their real business challenges.
* Participate in actual growth projects involving advertising, content, social media and other digital channels.
* Contribute ideas, help execute them and see how they perform in the real world.
* Learn how marketing decisions connect to customers, conversions and business growth.


 What will you walk away with?
 
 You’ll leave with real\-world business exposure, practical digital skills, sharper business thinking and actual work you can talk about in future interviews.
 



 More importantly, you’ll start understanding marketing not simply as ads, posts or content — but as a tool for growing a business.
   




 Who are we looking for?
 
 You don't need to already be a digital marketing expert.
 



 We're looking for someone who is:
 


* Curious about businesses, brands and why some grow faster than others
* Comfortable learning by doing
* Full of ideas, but equally willing to execute
* Proactive, responsible and willing to figure things out
* Interested in building serious real\-world skills early in their career



 Students from
 **marketing, management, commerce, communications or related backgrounds** 
 are welcome — but your attitude and curiosity matter more than your degree.

 🕐 𝗘𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: Full\-Time

 We’re a growing startup with a technically strong team, working on 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱\-𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘀 𝘁𝗮𝗿𝗴𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗨𝗦 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁.
 



  





 Our focus isn't simply to increase organic traffic or push a few keywords up Google.
 



  





 The real objective is simple:
 



  





 𝗧𝘂𝗿𝗻 𝗦𝗘𝗢 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗼 𝗮 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗰𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗲𝗱 𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘀.
 



  





 And that's where things get interesting.
 



  





 We work on SEO strategies across 𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝟱𝟬 𝗨𝗦 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗷𝗼𝗿 𝗰𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀, particularly for emergency and high\-intent service businesses. This involves a combination of 𝘁𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗘𝗢, 𝗼𝗻\-𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗦𝗘𝗢, 𝗼𝗳𝗳\-𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗦𝗘𝗢, 𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗘𝗢, 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆, 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗺𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰/𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗲𝘀, 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻.
 



  





 We're looking for someone with 𝟯\+ 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗱𝘀\-𝗼𝗻 𝗦𝗘𝗢 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 who enjoys figuring out \*why\* something works, testing new approaches, and building strategies rather than simply following an SEO checklist.
 



  





 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗯𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗼𝗻
 



  





 \* Developing and executing SEO strategies for US\-based lead\-generation websites
 



 \* Planning and implementing On\-Page, Off\-Page, Technical and Local SEO
 



 \* Building and scaling local SEO strategies across US states, cities and service areas
 



 \* Keyword research based on search intent, competition and commercial value
 



 \* Optimizing website architecture, internal linking and topical relevance
 



 \* Conducting technical SEO audits and resolving crawling, indexing and structural issues
 



 \* Working with sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, schema, redirects and other technical SEO elements
 



 \* Developing strategies for Google Maps / Local Pack and local organic visibility
 



 \* Building and executing quality\-focused backlink and authority\-building strategies
 



 \* Identifying content gaps and opportunities to build topical authority
 



 \* Analyzing Google Search Console, Google Analytics and SEO tool data
 



 \* Monitoring rankings, organic traffic and, most importantly, conversions/leads
 



 \* Experimenting with new SEO techniques and strategies
 



 \* Working closely with our content, development and marketing teams
 



 \* Using automation and AI tools where they can genuinely improve SEO workflows and efficiency
 



  





 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿
 



  





 \* 3\+ years of practical SEO experience
 



 \* Strong understanding of On\-Page, Off\-Page, Technical and Local SEO
 



 \* Experience with SEO for competitive markets
 



 \* Strong understanding of keyword research and search intent
 



 \* Ability to perform and interpret technical SEO audits
 



 \* Hands\-on experience with tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush or equivalent
 



 \* Good understanding of internal linking, topical authority and site architecture
 



 \* Experience with Local SEO and location\-based search strategies
 



 \* Ability to analyze data and turn it into actionable SEO decisions
 



 \* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
 



 \* Good communication and documentation skills
 



 \* Most importantly, curiosity and a willingness to experiment
 



  





 𝗜𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗯𝗲 𝗮 𝗽𝗹𝘂𝘀 𝗶𝗳 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲
 



  





 \* Experience with US SEO
 



 \* Experience working with emergency\-service or other high\-intent local businesses
 



 \* Experience managing SEO across multiple locations
 



 \* Experience with Google Business Profiles and Local Pack optimization
 



 \* Experience with programmatic/local landing page strategies
 



 \* Experience with large websites or websites targeting hundreds of locations
 



 \* Knowledge of structured data/schema
 



 \* Experience with SEO automation, AI\-assisted workflows or tools such as n8n
 



 \* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript from an SEO perspective
 



  





 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁?
 



  





 We're a startup, so we're not looking for someone whose job is to:
 



  





 “Find keywords → write blogs → build some backlinks → send a monthly report.”
 



  





 Our approach is much more experimental.
 



  





 You'll be working alongside a technically strong team where SEO, development, content, data and automation come together.
 



  





 You'll have the opportunity to test ideas, analyze results, build new processes and contribute to strategies that can be deployed across multiple US markets at scale.
 



  





 If you enjoy SEO because you genuinely like figuring things out, rather than just following a predefined SOP, you'll probably enjoy working with us.
 



  





 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻 𝘄𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿
 



  





 You don't need to know every SEO technique in existence.
 



  





 But you should be someone who:
 



  





 Questions → Researches → Tests → Measures → Learns → Improves.
 



  





 We value people who can look at a website and say:
 



  





 \> “I think this is the problem. Here's what I'd test, here's why, and here's how we'll measure whether it worked.”
 



  





 📍 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗶𝘀 𝗮𝗻 𝗢𝗻\-𝗦𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝗻 𝗔𝗵𝗺𝗲𝗱𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗱
 



  





 If you're looking for a role where you can work on 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗘𝗢 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗺𝘀, 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗨𝗦 𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁𝘀, 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗘𝗢 𝗮𝘁 𝘀𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, we'd love to hear from you.

**Job Title: Ecommerce Marketplace Specialist** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Looking for an
 **Ecommerce Marketplace Specialist** 
 to drive the growth and performance of our brands across leading online marketplaces such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, AJIO, Nykaa Fashion, and quick\-commerce platforms** 
 .
 



 The role will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end marketplace operations, improving product visibility and conversion, optimizing advertising campaigns, executing promotional initiatives, and generating actionable insights to maximize sales, profitability, and customer experience.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Marketplace Operations** 



* Manage end\-to\-end operations across ecommerce marketplaces, ensuring seamless execution and business growth.
* Conduct regular catalogue audits to maintain listing accuracy, content quality, pricing consistency, and inventory availability.
* Ensure timely execution of new product launches, catalogue updates, pricing changes, promotions, and marketplace initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with marketplace policies and maintain strong seller performance standards.
* Identify operational gaps and implement process improvements to improve efficiency and marketplace performance.



**Marketplace Performance \& Growth** 



* Monitor marketplace performance and prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports with actionable business insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, traffic, conversion rates, product visibility, and overall marketplace performance.
* Monitor key marketplace KPIs, including
 **sales, revenue, traffic, conversion rate, ACOS/TACOS, ROAS, returns, ratings, reviews, and inventory health** 
 .
* Use marketplace analytics and business data to develop recommendations and drive continuous growth.



**Advertising \& Promotions** 



* Plan, execute, and optimize marketplace advertising campaigns while managing budgets to maximize
 **ROAS and profitability** 
 .
* Execute promotional campaigns, deals, offers, and seasonal marketplace events.
* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for optimization.



**Inventory \& Competitor Management** 



* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with relevant teams to minimize stock\-outs and ensure marketplace availability.
* Track competitor pricing, promotions, assortment, visibility, and marketplace activities to identify growth opportunities.
* Maintain pricing and inventory consistency across marketplace platforms.



**Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Work closely with
 **Supply Chain, Creative, Catalog, Customer Experience, and Performance Marketing teams** 
 to execute business priorities.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely execution of marketplace activities.
* Take ownership of marketplace business outcomes and ensure smooth operational execution.



**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **3–4 years** 
 of experience in ecommerce marketplace management, marketplace growth, digital commerce, or a similar role.
* Experience managing marketplace operations for
 **consumer, fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or D2C brands** 
 will be preferred.
* Graduate degree in
 **Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with marketplace seller/vendor portals and advertising platforms is highly desirable.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The
 **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** 
 is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.
   

  

 Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**
* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.


**Customer Service Excellence**
* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.


**COD \& Documentation Management**
* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.


**Operational Compliance**
* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.


**Safety \& Security**
* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.


**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

**Job Purpose:**

The Executive ensures that all quantity surveying activities are well\-organized, accurate, and aligned with project requirements, contributing to the overall efficiency and success of the projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Review Drawings and Prepare Quantity Requirements:**
 Analyze detailed construction and design drawings to determine the quantity requirements for materials, labor, and resources.
   

  

 Ensure all calculations are precise and align with project specifications and design intent during the planning stage, avoiding any discrepancies during the construction phase that could affect timelines or costs.
   

  

**Scrutinize Maintenance And Material Costs**
 Evaluate material and labor costs early in the design phase to establish accurate project estimates and optimize resource allocation for both planning and construction.
   

  

 Review contracts and procurement strategies to ensure cost efficiency while maintaining compliance with design specifications, construction standards, and organizational requirements.
   

  

**Collaborate With Designers, Site Managers, And Contractors**
 Communicate regularly with architects, planners, engineers, site managers, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure that design elements are accurately translated into the construction process.
   

  

 Ensure that all parties are aligned with cost management strategies, project timelines, and the overall design vision, facilitating smooth coordination from planning to execution.
   

  

**Prepare Reports And Budgets**
 Develop comprehensive reports, including budget estimates, cost analyses, and material take\-offs, during both the planning and construction phases.
   

  

 Ensure that all documentation is thorough, accurate, and supports informed decision\-making, from early design adjustments to final construction cost controls.
   

  

**Advise On Cost\-Effective Design And Construction Solutions**
 Provide data\-driven recommendations to both design and construction teams on potential cost\-saving measures and alternative strategies.
   

  

 Use insights gathered from both planning and on\-site construction to help managers develop cost\-efficient, sustainable, and effective project plans, optimizing long\-term project performance.
   

  

**Document Changes And Update Budgets**
 Record and track any changes in project design and construction specifications meticulously, updating budgets and quantity requirements as needed.
   

  

 Ensure that all modifications are documented accurately and communicated to relevant stakeholders, maintaining transparency and ensuring seamless adjustments during the transition from planning to construction.

 Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in quantity surveying, Civil engineering, management, or a related field.

 3\-5 years of experience in an administrative or support role within the quantity surveying or construction field.

title: Paid Ads & Performance Lead
description:
**Job Description:** 




  





 Build Campaigns That Generate Real Business Growth.
 



  





 Software Co is an Australian AI\-native software, product and venture studio. We design, build and scale custom software, AI platforms and digital ventures for ambitious startups, scale\-ups and established organisations.
 



  





 Alongside Software Co, our growing digital and creative agency helps businesses build their brands, generate demand and accelerate growth through high\-performance digital marketing.
 



 We are looking for an exceptional Paid Media \& Performance Lead. Someone who combines deep technical capability, commercial thinking and hands\-on campaign execution with a demonstrated ability to generate measurable business results.
 



  





 This is not an entry\-level digital marketing role, and it is not a position for someone whose experience has primarily involved coordinating agencies or reviewing campaign reports.
 



 We are looking for a genuine performance marketing operator who knows how to get inside an advertising account, understand what is happening, identify opportunities, build campaigns, solve tracking and conversion problems, test aggressively and continuously improve results.You should understand the difference between generating traffic and generating revenue.Success in this role will ultimately be measured by the quality and commercial value of the opportunities you generate and not impressions, clicks or vanity metrics.
 



  





**Key Skills and experience:** 




  





 You will take hands\-on responsibility for the strategy, execution, optimisation and performance of paid acquisition campaigns across Software Co, our portfolio of technology ventures and selected Rockatoo clients.
 



  




* Your responsibilities will include:Developing and executing sophisticated paid acquisition strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.
* Planning, building and optimising Google Search, Performance Max, Display, Remarketing and YouTube campaigns.
* Building and scaling high\-performing Meta campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
* Generating qualified B2B leads and sales opportunities for software development, AI, SaaS and technology\-related services.
* Managing significant advertising budgets with disciplined commercial and ROI accountability.
* Understanding the economics behind each campaign, including CPL, CPA, CAC, conversion rate, ROAS, pipeline generated and revenue contribution.
* Conducting continuous experimentation across audiences, keywords, bidding strategies, offers, messaging, creative, landing pages and conversion funnels.
* Performing detailed keyword, search\-intent, audience and competitor analysis.
* Identifying why campaigns are underperforming and systematically solving the underlying problem.
* Designing and improving acquisition funnels from first impression through to enquiry, qualification and conversion.
* Working closely with designers and content teams to develop advertising creative based on performance data and structured testing.
* Collaborating with sales teams to understand lead quality, not simply lead volume, and feeding this intelligence back into campaign optimisation.
* Establishing accurate conversion tracking and attribution across advertising platforms, websites, landing pages and CRM systems.
* Developing dashboards and reporting that clearly communicate performance, insights, opportunities and next actions.
* Staying at the forefront of Google's and Meta's evolving advertising platforms, automation capabilities, AI tools and emerging performance\-marketing practices.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 We want someone who can personally get into the detail.
 



  




* You should be highly competent across:Google Ads
* Meta Ads Manager
* LinkedIn Ads
* Google Analytics 4
* Google Tag Manager
* Conversion and event tracking
* Pixels and server\-side/conversion APIs
* UTM and campaign attribution
* Landing\-page optimisation
* Conversion\-rate optimisation
* Audience segmentation and remarketing
* CRM attribution and lead\-source tracking
* Performance reporting and analytics



  





 You should be comfortable diagnosing tracking discrepancies, understanding attribution problems and determining what is actually generating commercial outcomes.
 



 What We're Looking For
 



  





 We care significantly more about what you have achieved than what certifications you hold.
 


* Ideally, you will have:5\+ years of serious hands\-on experience managing and optimising paid advertising campaigns.
* Deep practical expertise across both Google Ads, Meta Ads \& LinkedIn Ads.
* A demonstrable history of generating measurable ROI from paid acquisition.
* Strong experience with B2B lead generation, particularly where customer acquisition involves higher\-value or longer sales cycles.
* Experience personally managing substantial advertising budgets.
* Strong knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking and attribution.
* Experience building and optimising landing pages and conversion funnels.
* Strong analytical capability and confidence working with campaign and commercial data.
* An understanding of the relationship between marketing spend, qualified pipeline, customer acquisition cost and revenue.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to clearly explain what is working, what isn't, why, and what should happen next.
* A strong bias toward action, experimentation and continuous improvement.



  





 Most importantly, you should be able to show us real campaigns and real results.
 



  





 Highly Desirable
 


* Experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:Software development or technology services marketing.
* SaaS and subscription businesses.
* AI products and platforms.
* High\-value B2B lead generation.
* LinkedIn Ads.
* HubSpot, Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
* Marketing automation and lead\-nurturing systems.
* Server\-side tracking and Conversion APIs.
* Call and offline conversion tracking.
* AI\-assisted campaign analysis, creative development and optimisation.
* Conversion\-rate optimisation and landing\-page experimentation.
* Multi\-brand or agency environments.



  





 The Person Who Will Thrive Here
 



  





 You are technical, tactical and commercially driven.
 



 You don't wait for someone else to tell you why a campaign isn't working. You investigate it.You don't accept a falling conversion rate as something to put into next week's report. You want to understand why it happened and what can be changed today.
 


* You are:Highly analytical and data\-driven.
* Commercially minded.
* Intensely curious.
* Technically capable.
* Hands\-on and execution\-focused.
* Comfortable taking ownership.
* Naturally experimental.
* Detail\-oriented without losing sight of the commercial objective.
* Comfortable being accountable for measurable outcomes.
* Constantly looking for the next optimisation opportunity.



  





 You understand that great performance marketing comes from hundreds of intelligent decisions and experiments compounded over time.
 



 And when something works, your instinct is to ask How do we scale it?
 



  





  





 Why Join Us?
 



 This is an opportunity to work across an unusually diverse portfolio of technology, AI and digital businesses.
 


* You will have the opportunity to:Work alongside an ambitious Australian AI\-native software and technology company.
* Help grow Software Co's own customer\-acquisition engine.
* Work across innovative software, SaaS and AI products spanning multiple industries.
* Build and scale campaigns through Rockatoo for a growing portfolio of clients.
* Work with modern advertising, analytics, automation and AI technology.
* Have significant autonomy over campaign strategy and execution.
* Test ideas quickly without unnecessary layers of bureaucracy.
* Work directly with marketing, creative, technology and sales teams.
* Take genuine ownership of performance.
* Earn competitive remuneration with performance incentives for exceptional results.
* Grow into a broader leadership position as our performance marketing capability expands.



  





 How to ApplyWe don't want a generic application telling us that you're "passionate about digital marketing."
 



 Show us what you've done.
 


* Along with your resume, please provide examples of campaigns you have personally managed and optimised, including wherever possible:Monthly advertising spend.
* Industry and target audience.
* CPL and CPA.
* Conversion rates.
* ROAS or revenue generated.
* Lead volumes and lead quality.
* Improvements you personally achieved.
* What wasn't working when you inherited or launched the campaign.
* What you changed.
* What happened as a result.



  





 Case studies, screenshots, dashboards or portfolio examples are strongly encouraged where confidentiality permits.
 



 During the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates should also be prepared to walk us through a real campaign, explain their thinking and demonstrate how they approach campaign analysis and optimisation.
 



 Immediate Start Available
 



 If you're the kind of performance marketer who gets excited about opening an advertising account, finding opportunities others have missed and turning advertising spend into measurable business growth, we want to speak with you.

title: IT Executive (Website & Email Management, IT Operations)
description:
We are hiring: IT Executive (Website \& Email Management, IT Operations)
 



 Worth Minds \| Ahmedabad \| Work from office \| Full\-time
 



 ₹18,000–₹25,000 per month \| 1–3 years of experience
 



  





 Keep our websites running, our email reliable and our team connected.
 



 Join Worth Minds and take ownership of its Laravel editorial platform and INOBAL’s PHP website through their admin panels, alongside social media content creation and publishing, our email infrastructure and everyday office IT. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems and following them through to completion.
 



  





 ABOUT WORTH MINDS
 



 Worth Minds is INOBAL’s editorial platform. Based in Ahmedabad, this role supports the platform’s publishing operations, email infrastructure and everyday IT, alongside INOBAL and client website projects. INOBAL works with founders, executives and organisations across the US, UK, Europe, Africa and India.
 



  





 WEBSITE \& ADMIN PANEL MANAGEMENT
 



 • Manage the admin panels of INOBAL (PHP) and Worth Minds (Laravel), including content, categories, menus, profiles and user permissions.
 



 • Build and publish pages, landing pages, articles, images, videos and features using available admin tools; check structure, styling, links and mobile display.
 



 • Coordinate with marketing and editorial teams on updates, and with developers on code changes, new features and complex issues.
 



 • Monitor uptime, page speed, Core Web Vitals and errors; maintain backups, SSL renewals, malware checks and website security.
 



 • Manage hosting panels, domains, subdomains, DNS and staging environments.
 



 • Maintain on\-page SEO, including titles, descriptions, alt text, URLs, sitemaps and schema where supported.
 



 • Maintain forms, popups, chat widgets and lead capture flows; manage Google Analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager and tracking pixels.
 



 • Support client website builds, redesigns, migrations and maintenance; share reports on traffic, speed, errors and uptime.
 



  





 EMAIL MANAGEMENT \& DELIVERABILITY
 



 • Create, configure and manage business email accounts across Google Workspace and other providers.
 



 • Set up and maintain SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for company and campaign domains.
 



 • Coordinate domain purchases and configure new outreach domains and mailboxes, including sending setup and warm\-up.
 



 • Monitor inbox placement, sender reputation, bounce rates and blocklist status; troubleshoot deliverability issues.
 



 • Manage sales outreach platforms and email sending infrastructure.
 



 • Set up signatures, aliases, forwarding, distribution groups and shared mailboxes.
 



 • Handle mailbox storage, archiving, recovery and employee offboarding.
 



 • Maintain spam filtering, phishing protection and access controls, with clear records of domains, mailboxes and DNS settings.
 



  





 IT OPERATIONS
 



 • Provide first\-level support for hardware, software, networks and account access.
 



 • Configure new joiner laptops, software and accounts; administer Google Workspace users, permissions, storage and security settings.
 



 • Maintain the IT asset register, licences, subscriptions and renewal calendar.
 



 • Coordinate internet, routers, printers, CCTV and office infrastructure with vendors.
 



 • Maintain backup routines and cybersecurity practices; work with hosting providers, registrars, software vendors and AMC partners.
 



  





 SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATION \& PUBLISHING
 



 • Create social media posts, carousels, banners, stories and basic short videos or reels for Worth Minds, INOBAL and assigned client projects.
 



 • Turn articles, interviews and brand updates into engaging captions, visuals and short\-form content, working from marketing and editorial briefs.
 



 • Upload, schedule and publish approved content across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other assigned channels.
 



 • Maintain a content calendar and coordinate drafts, approvals and publishing deadlines with the team.
 



 • Adapt formats for each platform; check captions, spelling, links, tags, hashtags, thumbnails and brand consistency before posting.
 



 • Use Canva or similar tools for creatives and basic video editing, including trimming, subtitles and resizing.
 



 • Monitor comments and messages, route enquiries to the right team and flag issues that need attention.
 



 • Track reach, engagement, clicks and follower growth; share simple reports and suggest content improvements.
 



 • Keep social media profiles, bios, links and asset folders updated, and manage account access securely.
 



  





 DIGITAL SUPPORT
 



 • Support marketing with landing pages, email templates, integrations and automation.
 



 • Administer CRM, project management, outreach and AI tools; build simple workflows that reduce manual work.
 



 • Prepare basic banners and web graphics when required.
 



 • Document processes and system information securely, and support additional IT and digital operations as the business grows.
 



  





 WHAT YOU BRING
 



 • 1–3 years of experience in website management, email administration or IT support.
 



 • Confidence with website admin panels and content publishing, plus a working understanding of PHP and Laravel websites.
 



 • Working knowledge of DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and business email troubleshooting.
 



 • Basic HTML and CSS, with an understanding of JavaScript.
 



 • Familiarity with cPanel or Plesk, FTP, databases, website security, caching and speed optimisation.
 



 • Experience with Google Workspace administration.
 



 • Ability to create basic social media graphics, write clear captions and upload or schedule content; familiarity with Canva and basic video editing.
 



 • A degree in IT, Computer Science, BCA, MCA or an equivalent field.
 



 • Good English communication, organised documentation and ownership of requests from multiple teams.
 



  





 NICE TO HAVE
 



 • Experience with cold email or outreach infrastructure.
 



 • WordPress, Elementor and plugin management experience for relevant client projects.
 



 • Photoshop, social media scheduling tools and practical use of AI tools.
 



  





 YOUR GROWTH
 



 Gain exposure to every part of the business, with a path towards Digital Operations Specialist and senior IT positions as our web, email and client work expands.
 



  





 APPLY NOW
 



 Email your CV and links to websites you have built or managed to career@inobal.com.
 



 Subject: Application for IT Executive
 



 Include examples of social media posts, creatives or videos you have worked on, and briefly mention the admin panels, email platforms and technical responsibilities you have handled.
 



  





 Ahmedabad • Work from office • Full\-time
 



 ₹18,000–₹25,000 per month

+ Provide guidance on LinkedIn optimization and professional branding.
+ Conduct mock interviews and support behavioral and screening interview preparation.
+ Help students develop STAR stories, elevator pitches, and effective self\-introductions.
+ Provide constructive feedback on communication, confidence, clarity, and answer structure.
+ Track student progress, follow up on action items, and maintain coaching records.
+ Support career workshops, group coaching sessions, and office hours.
+ Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a smooth student experience.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

This role focuses on ensuring the business optimizes its processes and reduces inefficiencies through solutions like CWS, SPS, and BPR. The BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead will track performance metrics, standardize processes, and implement best practices that improve quality, compliance, and overall business performance. This role will work cross\-functionally to ensure that the organization is continuously improving, achieving operational goals, and reducing risks.

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

 Vendors and Technology Providers

title: Digital Growth Lead
description:
**We're hiring: Digital Growth Lead — Karma Ventures** 




  





 We're looking for one person to help build the digital growth engine across Karma.
 



 Karma Workspaces is part of the broader Karma Ventures group, and we're using our existing
 



 community to help us find the right person to join us.
 



 I'm looking for someone to take ownership of the digital growth journey at Karma Ventures.
 



  





 Karma is building a portfolio of real\-estate businesses across Gujarat — industrial \& logistics,
 



 workspaces, commercial real estate and new development opportunities. The role will work
 



 across Karma Ventures and its businesses, including KLIP and Karma Workspaces.
 



  





**This is not a traditional digital marketing or social media role.** 




  





 I'm looking for someone who can understand a business deeply, think commercially, build the
 



 digital strategy, work with our existing SEO / website / content partners, generate meaningful
 



 business opportunities, use data to understand what is working, and increasingly use AI and
 



 automation to make the whole system better.
 



  





 There are two parts of the role that are particularly important to me:
 



  





**1\. Make organic digital growth work.** 




 Build our SEO and organic search presence so that the right businesses and decision\-makers
 



 discover us. Use content where it has a clear purpose — across our website, Instagram,
 



 LinkedIn and other relevant channels — not simply to keep social media active. This also
 



 includes supporting Karma Ventures' digital presence and my own LinkedIn strategy and
 



 outreach — my voice stays personal; your role is to help make that presence more strategic and
 



 effective.
 



  





**2\. Create opportunities directly.** 




 Identify relevant companies and decision\-makers, build targeted prospect lists, reach out through
 



 thoughtful, targeted personal outreach and other digital channels, develop relationships and turn
 



 those conversations into genuine business opportunities.
 



  





 Around these two priorities, you'll build the infrastructure that makes the system work —
 



 websites, landing pages, analytics, CRM, lead tracking, dashboards and reporting — and use AI
 



 and automation wherever it can remove repetitive work.
 



  





 This role is focused on organic growth and direct digital business development. It is not a paid\-
 



 marketing role, and paid marketing will not sit within this role's remit.
 



 More importantly, I'm looking for someone who is self\-driven, energetic, curious and takes
 



 genuine ownership of their work. Someone who sees something that needs to be done and
 



 doesn't wait to be told what to do — but is also comfortable telling me when they think we're
 



 doing something wrong.
 



 You will have significant autonomy, with the opportunity to work closely with the founder on
 



 business priorities and digital strategy. The intention is to find someone who can grow with
 



 Karma over the long term.
 



  





**Must\-have skills** 




 •Able to understand a business model, customer, sales cycle and commercial objective before
 



 deciding what digital activity to pursue.
 



 •3–6 years in digital marketing, growth or a related commercial role, with evidence of owning
 



 outcomes.
 



 •Strong working understanding of SEO, search intent, Google Search Console and GA4\.
 



 •Good understanding of websites/CMS, landing pages and conversion optimisation.
 



 •Comfortable with CRM, lead tracking and digital analytics.
 



 •Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — comfortable working with data, using formulas, sorting/
 



 filtering datasets, creating simple analyses and dashboards, and turning the numbers into
 



 decisions.
 



 •Comfortable using LinkedIn and other digital channels for prospecting and direct business
 



 development.
 



 •Experience briefing and managing SEO, website, content, development or other external
 



 specialists.
 



 •Strong written and verbal English.
 



 •Genuine interest in AI and automation and practical application of both.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Formal qualifications matter less to us than what you've actually built, solved and owned.
 



  





**Location: Ahmedabad / Hybrid** 




 The role is based around Ahmedabad. The first three months will involve more regular in\-person
 



 interaction with the founder and team. Once the role and working rhythm are established, we are
 



 open to a hybrid arrangement — broadly around one week in Ahmedabad each month and the
 



 balance remotely. Exceptional candidates based elsewhere can also be considered.
 



  





**To apply, please send** 




**Current compensation:** 




**Expected compensation:** 




**Notice period:** 




**Location:** 




 We are open to discussing compensation for the right person based on capability, experience
 



 and fit.
 



  





 Along with short answers to these three questions:
 



 1\.Tell us about one digital/growth problem you personally solved. What did you do and what
 



 measurable result did it produce?
 



 2\.Tell us about a dashboard or reporting system you have built or managed. What information
 



 did it bring together, and how did you use it to make a decision or improve performance?
 



 3\.Imagine paid marketing is not available to you, and Karma has a strong website but very little
 



 relevant organic traffic or qualified enquiries. What would you look at first, and how would you
 



 decide what to fix?
 



  





 I'm much more interested in what you have actually done and how you think than in a long list of
 



 responsibilities on a CV.
 



 Please DM me or send your CV \+ answers to careers@karmaventures.co.in.
 



  





 And if you know someone who would be a particularly good fit, I'd appreciate you tagging them
 



 or passing this on.

**Job Description: Accounts Manager – Intern CA / CMA \| Ahmedabad** 




  





**Department:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
 



  





**Reporting To:** 
 Finance Manager
 



  





**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Work Location:** 
 In\-person (Head Office)\- Ahmedabad
 



  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an Accounts Manager – CA / CMA \| Ahmedabad to manage end\-to\-end accounting operations supporting our e\-commerce and retail distributor channels. The role involves maintaining accurate books of accounts for multi\-channel sales operations, managing distributor receivables, ensuring GST compliance across channels, and coordinating closely with Sales, Operations, and other teams. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on SAP experience and prior exposure to e\-commerce and distribution channel accounting in FMCG or retail environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Financial Management \& Accounting** 




  




* Maintain accurate books of accounts for e\-commerce and retail distributor channel operations.
* Ensure timely recording of all financial transactions related to sales and channel\-specific expenses.
* Monitor channel profitability and operational costs; analyze and report variances to management.
* Manage and reconcile distributor accounts, trade receivables, and payment collection tracking.
* Implement strong internal controls for channel transaction management and expense tracking.



  





**GST \& Tax Compliance** 




  




* Ensure comprehensive GST compliance across all sales channels (e\-commerce, distributors, direct retail).
* Manage GST classification for different product categories and sales channels.
* Oversee Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation and optimization across channels.
* Support GST return data validation (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-2, GSTR\-3B) across channel transactions.
* Ensure compliance with TDS and other statutory requirements.
* Support GST audits, assessments, and statutory filings related to channel operations.
* Maintain accurate documentation for compliance and audits.



  





**Vendor \& Distributor Coordination** 




  




* Verify purchase and distributor invoices for GST accuracy and ensure proper accounting.
* Coordinate with Sales and Channel Management teams for proper documentation and compliance.
* Support distributor billing, payment terms, and settlement processes.
* Monitor credit notes, returns, and allowances across channels.



  





**E\-Commerce Platform Management** 




  




* Manage accounting for e\-commerce platform transactions (marketplace, own website).
* Reconcile e\-commerce platform statements with accounts records.
* Track platform charges, commissions, and promotional expenses.
* Ensure proper GST treatment for different e\-commerce transaction types.
* Coordinate with digital marketing and sales on promotional spend tracking.



  





**Team Supervision \& Process Management** 




  




* Supervise accounts executives and channel accounting staff.
* Provide guidance, training, and ensure timely completion of accounting activities.
* Ensure adherence to company financial policies and procedures.
* Prepare financial reports and MIS for channel performance analysis.
* Drive process improvements and standardisation in channel accounting.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* CMA / MBA (Finance) / CA Inter / M.Com / B.Com



  





**Experience** 




  




* 5–8 years of accounting experience with mandatory exposure to multi\-channel sales operations, e\-commerce, or distribution channel accounting.
* Preferred experience in FMCG, retail, or e\-commerce companies with distributor and online sales channels.



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 




  




* **Strong GST knowledge and hands\-on compliance experience across multiple sales channels** 
 (MANDATORY)
* **SAP working knowledge** 
 (MANDATORY)
* Strong understanding of multi\-channel accounting (e\-commerce, distributor, direct retail)
* Experience with distributor receivables management and trade credit control
* Knowledge of e\-commerce platform accounting and reconciliation
* Knowledge of TDS compliance
* Ability to coordinate with cross\-functional teams (Sales, Logistics, Digital, Channel Management)



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience with marketplace platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, etc.)

title: Senior Associate – Urban Climate Resilience
description:
**About Mahila Housing Trust (MHT)** 




  





 Mahila Housing Trust (MHT) builds secure housing and resilient living environments for low\-income women and girls. Technology is central to how we drive social change — from gathering the data needed to understand urban challenges to designing solutions that reduce climate risk.
 



 MHT strengthens essential civic and housing infrastructure, including water, sanitation, drainage, solid waste management, roads, electricity/energy, low\-income housing, and secure land tenure. Using data\-driven insights, spatial analysis, and digital tools, we connect communities to financial, legal, and technical services in housing, water, sanitation, and energy. This approach keeps our work community\-driven, scalable, and evidence\-based — improving lives and livelihoods for underprivileged women.
 



 MHT runs several Climate Resilience Initiatives that tackle urban heat, climate risk, and vulnerability in low\-income communities. These projects combine spatial analysis, community\-driven data collection, and evidence\-based advocacy to build resilience and improve living conditions for marginalized populations.
 



**Role and Responsibilities** 




 The Senior Associate – Urban Climate Resilience supports MHT's climate resilience initiatives through project management, reporting, and representation. Core responsibilities:
 



 \- Report Drafting \& Documentation: Write clear, high\-quality reports, briefs, and presentations on project progress, findings, and outcomes for donors, partners, and stakeholders. Edit for readability and flow, and strengthen structure and sequencing across documents.
 



 \- Climate and Heat Action Plans: Lead the preparation of Climate Action Plans, Heat Action Plans, and urban resilience strategies — including risk assessments, vulnerability analysis, stakeholder consultations, policy review, and adaptation and mitigation measures. Check calculations, assumptions, and analysis for errors or gaps.
 



 \- Geospatial and Data Analysis: Analyze urban, climate, and socio\-economic data, and turn it into clear dashboards, maps, and visualizations using ArcGIS, QGIS, Tableau, Power BI, R, or similar tools, to support evidence\-based decisions.
 



 \- Resilience Integration: Help integrate blue\-green infrastructure, nature\-based solutions, and community\-centered approaches into city planning and resilience frameworks.
 



 \- Conference \& Representation: Represent MHT at conferences, workshops, and forums, and communicate its work and impact clearly.
 



 \- Project Management Support: Help plan, monitor, and coordinate project activities so outputs are delivered on time.
 



 \- Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with partner organizations, government agencies, and community groups to strengthen collaboration and advocacy.
 



 \- Knowledge Management: Conduct literature reviews, compile secondary data, and contribute to knowledge products on MHT's climate resilience work.
 



 \- Continuous Learning: Track emerging trends in climate resilience, climate policy, and urban planning to keep MHT's strategies current.
 



**Requirements:** 




**Education:** 
 Master's degree in Urban Planning, Urban Development, or a related field.
 



**Experience:** 
 4–8 years in project management, development practice, or urban/climate resilience work.
 



**Skills:** 




 \- Experience developing and implementing urban resilience strategies, including Heat Action Plans, Climate Action Plans, blue\-green infrastructure interventions, land\-use planning, and nature\-based solutions.
 



 \- Strong report writing and documentation skills.
 



 \- Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi (Gujarati is a plus).
 



 \- Ability to coordinate across diverse teams and stakeholders.
 



 \- Proficiency in geospatial tools such as ArcGIS and QGIS.
 



 \- Proficiency in Adobe InDesign.
 



 \- A strong eye for design, able to produce polished report layouts with a consistent visual style and clear navigation.
 



**What We're Looking For:** 




 \- Passion for climate resilience, social impact, and community development.
 



 \- Patience and a collaborative approach in diverse teams.
 



 \- Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
 



**Compensation:** 
 Based on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

**JOB DESCRIPTION: BRIDGE DESIGN ENGINEER** 




**Department:** 
 Infrastructure / Structural Design
 



**Company:** 
 Shilpcore Consultants LLP

 Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On\-site)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time, Permanent
 



**Experience Level:** 
 2 – 4 Years
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Senior Bridge Engineer / Team Lead
 



**Job Purpose** 




 The Bridge Design Engineer is responsible for preparing, analyzing, and finalizing structural drawings and layouts for bridge and highway infrastructure projects. The role primarily focuses on developing General Arrangement Drawings (GAD), executing Cross Drainage (CD) structure designs, and ensuring structural compliance with IRC/MoRTH codes.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Drawings \& Detailing (GAD \& CD Structures)**
* Prepare and detail General Arrangement Drawings (GAD) for minor bridges, major bridges, flyovers, ROBs, and RUBs.
* Develop detailed reinforcement and construction drawings for CD structures, including single/multi\-cell box culverts, slab culverts, and pipe culverts.
* Prepare and verify structural schedules, including Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) and structural quantity take\-offs (BOQ).
* **Hydraulic \& Alignment Integration**
* Interpret hydrological data (Design Discharge, High Flood Level \[HFL], Scour Depth, Waterway requirements) and translate them into functional GAD elevations and foundation levels.
* Coordinate with highway geometric design teams to integrate vertical profiles, horizontal curves, superelevations, and skew angles into structural layouts.
* **Code Compliance \& Quality Assurance**
* Ensure all structural models, layouts, and detailing strictly comply with relevant codes: IRC:5, IRC:6, IRC:78, IRC:83, IRC:112, and MoRTH specifications.
* Conduct internal checks on drawing deliverables for dimensional accuracy, reinforcement clearances, bearing pedestals, expansion joints, and drainage details.
* **Coordination \& Approvals**
* Address and incorporate technical observations raised by Proof Consultants, Independent Engineers (IE), Authority Engineers (AE), NHAI, or State PWDs.
* Liaise with site engineers to address technical queries (RFIs) and clarify drawing details during construction.



**Candidate Profile \& Qualifications** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Civil Engineering. Master’s degree (M.E. / M.Tech) in Structural Engineering is strongly preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 2 to 4 years of proven structural drafting and design experience within an infrastructure design consultancy.
* **Technical Skills:**
* High proficiency in
 **AutoCAD** 
 (2D structural detailing, layer management, xrefs).
* Working knowledge of structural analysis software (e.g.,
 **STAAD.Pro** 
 ,
 **midas Civil** 
 ) is an asset.
* Strong working familiarity with standard IRC load classifications and standard drawing templates.
* **Competencies:** 
 Strong spatial reasoning, precision in numeric detailing, analytical problem\-solving, and clear technical communication.

The Lead also works closely with retail clients to ensure their space requirements are met, while maintaining strong tenant relationships to encourage lease renewals and long\-term occupancy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Develop and Optimize Tenant Mix for Retail Leasing:**
 Lead the development and execution of retail leasing strategies aimed at attracting a diverse mix of retailers that align with the mall’s positioning and market.
   

  

 Ensure that leasing activities drive footfall, support long\-term profitability, and enhance the mall’s status as a top retail destination.
   

  

**Market Research And Retail Prospect Identification**
 Conduct in\-depth market research to track retail trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities, using this data to strategically target retailers that appeal to mall visitors.
   

  

 Identify and approach retail brands that can help increase footfall and fill gaps in the current tenant mix to improve the mall’s retail offerings.
   

  

**Retail Tenant Negotiation And Lease Management**
 Oversee the retail leasing process from initial discussions through to agreement finalization, ensuring lease terms meet both the mall’s commercial goals and tenant needs.
   

  

 Negotiate complex retail lease terms such as rental rates, store size, fit\-outs, and terms aligned with the retailer’s business model while ensuring legal and financial compliance.
   

  

**Retail Tenant Relationship Management And Support**
 Maintain strong relationships with retail tenants, acting as their primary point of contact to resolve issues and provide support throughout their tenancy.
   

  

 Build and nurture long\-term partnerships by addressing tenant concerns and ensuring smooth lease renewals to foster a thriving retail environment.
   

  

**Collaborating On Store Openings And Retail Layouts**
 Work closely with marketing, operations, and design teams to ensure smooth store openings and optimal retail space utilization that maximizes footfall.
   

  

 Coordinate efforts to align tenant store designs with mall standards and promote visibility, creating engaging customer experiences that drive foot traffic.
   

  

**Footfall Analysis And Retail Reporting**
 Analyze retail leasing performance by tracking key metrics such as footfall, occupancy rates, and rental income, and develop strategies for the effectiveness of leasing strategies.

 Ensure that all retail leasing activities, including lease agreements, tenant correspondence, and store design approvals, are accurately documented.
   

  

 Provide regular reports on retail occupancy, footfall patterns, rental yields, and tenant sales performance, delivering valuable insights for strategic decision\-making.

title: Associate, Community Manager
description:

 e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face.

The Community Manager will connect with our fans on Social, and will manage Social inbounds, lead proactive engagement opportunities, track feedback and identify ways to celebrate our customers both on and offline, laddering up to the broader Community strategy. The right candidate is deeply ingrained in Social and the overarching beauty landscape, has a strong editorial voice and has a bias for action.
   

  

 The Associate, Community Manager will help foster the connection with our customer, amplifying their voices and sharing what’s trending in culture.
